svg.title: The record climb: thermals, then wave
svg.desc: How the highest flights are made: a range of big mountains, generic rather than a named peak, an altitude scale, and one climb: circling in thermals to 7,600 m, then straight up in wave to 8,400 m, as Antoine Girard describes his record flight. Painted: ranges paling with distance, a low sun behind the climb.
